pages.article_html:
The Wings of Authority

Level 4 · Diplomacy · Leth Nurae · Thestra

In the Order of the Azure Flame

Objectives

Speak to Lieutenant T'vos and who he indicates. Return to Preceptor Indradi when finished. - See What Lieutenant T'vos Turned Up - Question T'vos' Suspect

Description

Lieutenant T'vos -Sanctum of the Dragoon, loc -41647, -44939, 65704 in Leth Nurae (-25, 26). Princess Megalla - Near a hut surrounded by griffon nests, loc -54776, -64941, 64113 in Leth Nurae (-25, 26).

What they say

On taking it

Preceptor Indradi
"I need you to return to Lieutenant T'vos," Preceptor Indradi says, "and find out what he has discovered. As before, follow the trail, but return to me if there is any critical information you find out, or if the path will lead away form Leth Neurae." 'We need this bow back, so please hurry."

Recorded by wiki.silkyvenom.com.

Notes

Talk to Lieutenant T'vos and choose: "What have you discovered about our suspect?" Then find Princess Megalla. ===Princess Megalla=== location: The Wings of Authority :4 <gallery widths="175" orientation="portrait" spacing="small" captionalign="left"> Noble notions.JPG Good point.JPG Forceful demand.JPG Exchange of views.JPG </gallery>

2 recorded disagreements about this quest — loc (fandom), prev quest (silkyvenom).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

Description as recorded by mmodb

"I need you to return to Lieutenant T'vos," Preceptor Indradi says, "and find out what he has discovered. As before, follow the trail, but return to me if there is any critical information you find out, or if the path will lead away from Leth Nurae." "We need this bow back, so please, hurry."

findings.observation: Objectives require speaking to Lieutenant T'vos, questioning his suspect, and returning to Preceptor Indradi. Notes identifies Princess Megalla as the next interlocutor. These statements do not supply parley thresholds, event scripts, or canonical NPC IDs.

Details starter and hand-in both name Preceptor Indradi. Details location 31607, -62990, 67169 differs from Description locations -41647, -44939, 65704 for Lieutenant T'vos and -54776, -64941, 64113 for Princess Megalla. The latter both include Leth Nurae (-25, 26). Preserve distinct source contexts without coordinate conversion or verified spawns.

Two recorded disagreements identify loc (fandom) and prev quest (silkyvenom). No alternate values accompany these labels; full article and source records retain attribution. Unresolved location and predecessor collisions remain withheld.

Details Previous is Flight Of The Griffon, whose cached review reciprocally names this quest as Next. Details Next is Winding Roads. Navigation does not establish enforced prerequisites. Series Thestran Web Quests and Chain Thestra Web Quests remain distinct literal labels.

Dialogue credits wiki.silkyvenom.com; another description credits mmodb and links an archived original. Alternate objectives credit fandom; Source links thetelonproject.wikidot.com. Originals were not fetched here and mirrored accounts do not independently corroborate facts. Gallery filenames do not establish card rules.
Details Repeatable yes supplies no conditions and Coin reward 50 has no denomination. Retain the displayed reward without interpreting it as copper.
